about: The owner's calls on players ESPN's injury page still tags Out / Doubtful. .github/feeds.py copies the live entries to feeds notout.json; risk.js then shows 'Good to go' instead of 'Ruled out'. An entry lapses after its 'until' day, or as soon as ESPN posts a newer Out / Doubtful line for the player (see feeds.py).

Cam Skattebo.note: Good to go for Thursday. He was out last week; full participant in Tuesday's practice.
